phase_history.objective: Perform initial host and Active Directory discovery from the local foothold CASTELBLACK.
ability_names: Step 0 — Machine context check & AV/EDR Enumeration
Step 1 — Determine the local network range
Step 5 — Service / port enumeration on live hosts

narratives.text: We have committed an initial discovery plan targeting the CASTELBLACK foothold and its local subnet of 192.168.187.0/24. This phase focuses heavily on gathering local machine context, identifying active security controls, mapping out live hosts across the /24 network, and confirming the existence of any active Domain Controllers via lightweight TCP and LDAP/SMB banner querying. The output will establish our baseline network map, populate verified targets for Active Directory enumeration, and dynamically dictate whether we proceed to AD-specific targeting or local privilege escalation.

Initial discovery from CASTELBLACK (192.168.187.141) has successfully completed, identifying a domain-joined Windows Server 2019 instance with Windows Defender real-time protection disabled. Network scanning confirmed an active Active Directory environment for the domain 'north.sevenkingdoms.local'. A domain controller, 'winterfell.north.sevenkingdoms.local' (192.168.187.140), was identified with Kerberos, LDAP, and SMB services active. Another potential target with Kerberos and LDAP enabled was also discovered at 192.168.187.142. Next-phase recommendations point to active directory enumeration.
